purpose: Provisional online-research candidate dataset for #2112. It captures public-source leads and architecture/equipment/cost fields, but does not yet satisfy the no-invented-values gate for #2055.

required_gate.blocking_reason: Adversarial review found manifold, tieback_distance_km, and cost_usd_bn values mix direct facts with proxy/placeholder/cost-class seeds; not sufficient to remove status:needs-data from #2055.

data_policy.value_policy: Values are public-source or explicitly basis-coded from public-source architecture descriptors. Low-confidence/proxy-coded records are flagged and should be reviewed before engineering use.
data_policy.review_disposition: MAJOR: keep #2112/#2055 status:needs-data until primary-source values replace proxy/placeholder entries.

gom_fields.name: Perdido
gom_fields.architecture: Ultra-deepwater spar hub with direct-vertical-access and remote subsea wells tied back to the host; subsea boosting/flow-assurance enabled development.
gom_fields.num_trees_basis: NS Energy / Global Drilling public summaries describe 35 planned subsea wells: 22 direct vertical access wells plus 13 remote wells.
gom_fields.num_manifolds_basis: Proxy-coded from the three-field Perdido hub grouping commonly described for Great White, Tobago, and Silvertip; public search result confirms manifolds exist but the reviewed accessible source did not publish a precise count.
gom_fields.tieback_distance_km_basis: Prior repository scan captured 110 km flowlines for Perdido; public sources reviewed here confirm flowline-system focus but should be rechecked against the OTC/JPT paper before engineering use.
gom_fields.cost_usd_bn_basis: Approximate public project-cost class for Perdido-style deepwater spar development; retained as low-confidence seed for correlation only.

gom_fields.name: Appomattox
gom_fields.architecture: Integrated deepwater Appomattox/Vicksburg host with HP/HT subsea production system, drill centres, subsea trees/manifolds, and export pipelines.
gom_fields.num_trees_basis: Offshore Technology states TechnipFMC scope included 18 subsea trees for Appomattox.
gom_fields.num_manifolds_basis: Offshore Technology states TechnipFMC scope included four production manifolds.
gom_fields.tieback_distance_km_basis: Offshore Technology states crude export through the 90 mi / 145 km Mattox Pipeline; this is export/tieback length, not max well-to-host offset.
gom_fields.cost_usd_bn_basis: Public articles state Shell reduced Appomattox cost by ~20%; exact full cost not locked in reviewed source, so retained as low-confidence cost-class seed.

gom_fields.name: Whale
gom_fields.architecture: Vito-style four-column semi-submersible host with subsea wells tied back to host via subsea infrastructure and steel catenary risers.
gom_fields.num_trees_basis: Shell/S&P public summaries state a total of 15 wells will be tied back to the Whale host.
gom_fields.num_manifolds_basis: Proxy-coded from McDermott public statement that five steel catenary risers were installed; use as architecture complexity proxy until a manifold count is sourced.
gom_fields.tieback_distance_km_basis: Offshore Technology places Whale about 16 km from the Perdido floating oil platform; used as a regional tieback/proximity metric rather than Whale well-to-host offset.
gom_fields.cost_usd_bn_basis: Low-confidence cost-class seed for Vito-replicated deepwater host; replace with FID/project sanction cost when sourced.

gom_fields.name: Atlantis
gom_fields.architecture: Semi-submersible host with network of wet-tree subsea wells and phased subsea expansions tied back to the Atlantis platform.
gom_fields.num_trees_basis: Offshore Technology describes potential for more than 18 wet-tree subsea wells tied back to Atlantis; coded to the conservative threshold value 18.
gom_fields.num_manifolds_basis: Proxy-coded from public descriptions of manifold/pipeline-end-manifold replacement and expansion work; exact count remains a low-confidence review item.
gom_fields.tieback_distance_km_basis: No public max well-to-host tieback distance found in reviewed sources; coded 0 for host-local development seed and flagged low confidence.
gom_fields.cost_usd_bn_basis: Public ports/summary snippet captured $1.3B Atlantis Phase 3 expansion; base development cost not claimed.

gom_fields.name: Thunder Horse
gom_fields.architecture: Large semi-submersible production/drilling/quarters facility with wet-tree subsea wells and later subsea tieback/expansion drill centres.
gom_fields.num_trees_basis: NS Energy states Thunder Horse was developed with 25 wet-tree subsea wells tied back to the PDQ facility.
gom_fields.num_manifolds_basis: NS Energy/BP expansion descriptions identify a new two-slot subsea manifold and two subsea drill centres for expansion; coded as two manifolds/drill-centre units for correlation seed.
gom_fields.tieback_distance_km_basis: NS Energy states expansion wells/production system approximately 3.2 km north/south of Thunder Horse platform.
gom_fields.cost_usd_bn_basis: Low-confidence deepwater cost-class seed; exact base cost not asserted from reviewed source.

gom_fields.name: Mars / Mars B Olympus
gom_fields.architecture: Original Mars TLP plus Mars B/Olympus TLP with self-contained drilling rig, well slots, subsea wells at West Boreas/South Deimos, and export infrastructure.
gom_fields.num_trees_basis: Offshore Technology states Olympus features 24 well slots; used as dry-tree/well-slot count for equipment correlation.
gom_fields.num_manifolds_basis: Proxy-coded from two named subsea tieback fields in Mars B scope: West Boreas and South Deimos; exact manifold count not published in reviewed source.
gom_fields.tieback_distance_km_basis: Host-local/dry-tree TLP seed value; subsea tieback offset not sourced in reviewed public article.
gom_fields.cost_usd_bn_basis: Offshore Technology states initial Mars development cost was approximately $1B.

gom_fields.name: Mad Dog Phase 2 / Argos
gom_fields.architecture: Argos floating production unit serving southern/southwestern Mad Dog expansion with multiple drill centres, production and water-injection wells, SURF, subsea trees/manifolds/jumpers.
gom_fields.num_trees_basis: Offshore Technology states Mad Dog Phase 2 includes 14 production wells and eight water injectors.
gom_fields.num_manifolds_basis: Offshore Technology states wells are drilled from five drill centres; TechnipFMC supplied manifolds/jumpers. Drill-centre count is used as manifold-center proxy.
gom_fields.tieback_distance_km_basis: Offshore Technology states Argos is moored approximately 10 km south-west of existing Mad Dog spar; used as architecture/tieback separation metric.
gom_fields.cost_usd_bn_basis: Offshore Technology states revised Mad Dog Phase 2 cost was further reduced to $9B.

gom_fields.name: Stones
gom_fields.architecture: Ultra-deepwater subsea development tied back to Turritella FPSO with initial subsea production wells and later additional wells.
gom_fields.num_trees_basis: A Barrel Full / public Stones summaries describe initial two subsea production wells followed by six additional production wells.
gom_fields.num_manifolds_basis: Proxy-coded as two production-well phases/manifold clusters; public reviewed source did not expose a precise manifold count.
gom_fields.tieback_distance_km_basis: Prior repository scan captured Stones as a deepest subsea tieback around 20 km to host; public sources confirm Stones subsea-to-FPSO architecture.
gom_fields.cost_usd_bn_basis: Low-confidence FPSO/subsea cost-class seed; exact sanction cost not locked in reviewed source.

gom_fields.name: Lucius
gom_fields.architecture: Deepwater spar with six subsea production wells tied back via flowlines/risers, pipeline end manifolds, and spare connections for future tiebacks.
gom_fields.num_trees_basis: RAE public tieback-project page states Lucius involves six subsea production wells tied back to a moored production-handling spar.
gom_fields.num_manifolds_basis: AOGR public article describes pipeline end manifolds with spare connections and spar designed for two additional subsea tiebacks; coded two PLEM/manifold units for seed correlation.
gom_fields.tieback_distance_km_basis: No reviewed public max tieback length found; coded 0 for host-local spar tieback seed and flagged low confidence.
gom_fields.cost_usd_bn_basis: Low-confidence spar development cost-class seed; replace with sourced project cost when available.

gom_fields.name: Na Kika
gom_fields.architecture: Deepwater semi-submersible host serving multiple fields with subsea production system and first development wells drilled by Shell.
gom_fields.num_trees_basis: Offshore Technology search result/public project page states Shell drilled the first ten development wells for Na Kika.
gom_fields.num_manifolds_basis: Proxy-coded from six initial field centers in Na Kika hub scope; use as low-confidence manifold/field-center count until a direct subsea-manifold count is sourced.
gom_fields.tieback_distance_km_basis: No reviewed public max tieback length found; coded 0 for host-local multi-field hub seed and flagged low confidence.
gom_fields.cost_usd_bn_basis: Low-confidence public cost-class seed for early-2000s deepwater semi hub; exact cost requires source lock.
